sub_graphs.title: Altair: Fork Upgrade State Transition
sub_graphs.description: Models the state transformation when the beacon chain transitions from Phase 0 to Altair at the fork epoch boundary

nodes.label: Phase 0 Beacon State Active
nodes.description: The beacon chain is operating under Phase 0 rules with pending attestations and no participation flags

nodes.label: Check Altair Fork Epoch
nodes.description: During process_slots, check if state.slot % SLOTS_PER_EPOCH == 0 and the computed epoch equals ALTAIR_FORK_EPOCH

nodes.label: Execute upgrade_to_altair
nodes.description: Transform the Phase 0 state into an Altair state: copy all preserved fields, initialize new fields, translate participation data, assign sync committees

nodes.label: Translate Pending Attestations to Participation Flags
nodes.description: Process each Phase 0 pending attestation: determine applicable flag indices based on attestation data and inclusion delay, apply flags to all attesting validator indices

nodes.label: Assign Initial Sync Committees
nodes.description: Compute the sync committee and assign identical committees for both current_sync_committee and next_sync_committee

nodes.label: Update Fork Metadata
nodes.description: Set fork.previous_version to GENESIS_FORK_VERSION, fork.current_version to ALTAIR_FORK_VERSION, fork.epoch to ALTAIR_FORK_EPOCH

nodes.label: Altair Beacon State Active
nodes.description: The beacon chain is now operating under Altair rules with participation flags, inactivity scores, and sync committees

edges.label: Epoch boundary reached during slot processing

sub_graphs.title: Altair: Fork Transition Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation constraints during the Altair fork transition including participation flag translation and field initialization

nodes.label: Phase 0 Pending Attestations Available
nodes.description: The pre-fork state contains previous_epoch_attestations that must be translated

nodes.label: Validate Attestation for Translation
nodes.description: For each pending attestation, compute the get_attestation_participation_flag_indices to determine which flags apply based on attestation data, inclusion delay, and justification

nodes.label: Apply Participation Flags
nodes.description: For each attesting validator index, set the appropriate epoch_participation flags using bitwise OR

nodes.label: Participation Flags Initialized
nodes.description: All previous epoch participation flags correctly reflect the Phase 0 pending attestation data

nodes.label: New Altair Fields Initialized
nodes.description: All new Altair-specific state fields (participation, inactivity scores, sync committees) are initialized

sub_graphs.title: Altair: Sync Committee Initialization at Fork
sub_graphs.description: Models how sync committees are initialized during the Altair fork transition for consensus purposes

nodes.label: No Sync Committees (Phase 0)
nodes.description: Phase 0 state has no sync committee concept

nodes.label: Compute Sync Committee
nodes.description: Use get_next_sync_committee to compute a sync committee from the validator set using the Altair selection algorithm

nodes.label: Assign Duplicate Committee
nodes.description: Set both current_sync_committee and next_sync_committee to the same computed committee at the fork boundary

nodes.label: Sync Committees Active
nodes.description: Both current and next sync committees are assigned and operational for light client support

edges.label: Committee computed, duplicate for both slots

ambiguities.text: The specification states the upgrade must be embedded within process_slots rather than state_transition but does not explain the precise ordering relative to other epoch processing.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the fork upgrade occurs after the epoch boundary processing of the old fork and before the first slot processing of the new fork. This ordering is critical for correctness.

ambiguities.text: The translate_participation function processes 'each pending attestation' but does not specify behavior when attestation data references slots that span across multiple epochs.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume only attestations from previous_epoch_attestations are translated, as current_epoch_attestations are not mentioned in the upgrade function.

implicit_assumptions.description: All client implementations will execute the fork upgrade at exactly the same slot, producing an identical post-state.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Different upgrade timing would cause state divergence between clients, leading to a consensus split.

implicit_assumptions.description: The duplicate sync committee assignment at the fork boundary does not reduce security because the committee period is long enough for proper rotation to occur.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If the initial sync committee is compromised, both current and next committees are compromised simultaneously, creating a window where light client security is weakened.
